ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: In the attached figure there are two identical standard dice. The three visible faces of the die on the left are respectively: the top has 2 dots, the front has 1 dot, and the left side face has 3 dots. The visible faces of the die on the right are: the top has 6 dots, and the front has 4 dots; its right side face is marked by an arrow and “?”, and the number of dots needs to be determined. Reasoning: The sums of the numbers of dots on opposite faces of a standard die are 7, so the opposite of 1 is 6, the opposite of 2 is 5, and the opposite of 3 is 4. From the orientation of the die on the left, the relative positions of the same die can be fixed: the back of front 1 is 6, the bottom of top 2 is 5, and the right side of left side 3 is 4. Now rotate this die to the orientation of the die on the right: make 6 go to the top and make 4 go to the front. Tracking each face according to this rotation, the original bottom 5 will turn to the right side. Therefore the non-visible right side face pointed to by the question mark can only be 5 dots.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: the left die shows top = 2 dots, front = 1 dot, and left side = 3 dots; the right die shows top = 6 dots, front = 4 dots, and its right-hand face is hidden by the question mark. From the text, use that opposite faces sum to 7 and that the two dice are identical. On the left die, infer the unseen opposite faces: opposite 1 is 6, opposite 2 is 5, and opposite 3 is 4. Thus the same cube has front/right/back/top/bottom/left positions fixed relative to 1,2,3. Now rotate this labeled cube so that face 6 is on top and face 4 is in front, matching the right die. Track the face that moves to the right-hand side; it is 5. Therefore the hidden face can only have 5 dots.
method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：附图中有两个相同的标准骰子。左边骰子可见的三个面分别是：上面有2点，正面有1点，左侧面有3点。右边骰子可见的面是：上面有6点，正面有4点；它的右侧面被箭头和“?”标出，需要判断点数。

推理：标准骰子相对两面的点数和为7，所以1的对面是6，2的对面是5，3的对面是4。由左边骰子的朝向可固定同一个骰子的相对位置：正面1的背面是6，上面2的下面是5，左侧3的右侧是4。现在把这个骰子旋转到右边骰子的朝向：让6到上面，让4到正面。按这个旋转追踪各面，原来的下面5会转到右侧。因此问号所指的非可见右侧面只能是5点。

method.method_draft: First describe the image: one die has the corner formed by faces 2 on top, 1 on the front, and 3 on the left; the other die has 6 on top and 4 on the front, with the right face unknown. From the text, the dice are identical standard dice and opposite faces sum to 7. Instead of rotating the whole cube, use the corner/handedness relationship. The faces opposite to the first die's visible corner faces are: opposite 2 is 5, opposite 1 is 6, opposite 3 is 4. These three opposite faces meet at the opposite corner in a fixed cyclic order. Since the right die displays two of this opposite-corner triple, namely 6 and 4, in the positions top and front, the only face adjacent to both in the corresponding right-hand position is the remaining opposite-corner face, 5. Hence the hidden right-hand face is only 5.
